passages.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm of Asaph. A song.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
Asaph wrote this psalm.
This psalm is a song.
The choirmaster leads this song.
Musicians play stringed instruments for this song.

passages.text: God is known in Judah; His name is great in Israel.
passages.sermon:
This is a psalm.
Asaph wrote this psalm.
The psalm is for the choirmaster.
The psalm is for stringed instruments.
God is known in Judah.
God’s name is great in Israel.
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֥חַ בִּנְגִינֹ֑ת מִזְמ֖וֹר לְאָסָ֣ף שִֽׁיר׃ נוֹדָ֣ע בִּֽיהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּד֥וֹל שְׁמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.
passages.sermon:
God is the subject of this psalm.
God is known in Judah.
God’s name is great in Israel.
God’s tent is in Salem.
God’s dwelling place is in Zion.

passages.text: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
passages.sermon:
God acted in Zion.
God broke the flaming arrows there.
God shattered the shield and the sword there.
God destroyed all weapons of war there.
Pause and reflect.
God shines with bright light.
God is majestic.
God is greater than the mountains filled with prey.
passages.original: שָׁ֭מָּה שִׁבַּ֣ר רִשְׁפֵי־ קָ֑שֶׁת מָגֵ֬ן וְחֶ֖רֶב וּמִלְחָמָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃ נָ֭אוֹר אַתָּ֥ה אַדִּ֗יר מֵֽהַרְרֵי־ טָֽרֶף׃

passages.text: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
passages.sermon:
God defeated the brave and strong.
The valiant fell and could not rise.
They slept the sleep of death.
No mighty warrior could use his hands.
God’s power left them helpless.
passages.original: אֶשְׁתּוֹלְל֨וּ׀ אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑ם וְלֹא־ מָצְא֖וּ כָל־ אַנְשֵׁי־ חַ֣יִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
passages.sermon:
God is the God of Jacob.
God rebukes with power.
At God's rebuke, horses fall.
At God's rebuke, riders fall.
Both horse and rider lie stunned.
passages.original: מִ֭גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְרֶ֣כֶב וָסֽוּס׃

passages.text: You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
passages.sermon: God is awesome and inspires fear.\r\nNo one can stand before God when He is angry.
passages.original: אַתָּ֤ה׀ נ֥וֹרָא אַ֗תָּה וּמִֽי־ יַעֲמֹ֥ד לְפָנֶ֗יךָ מֵאָ֥ז אַפֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah Even the wrath of man shall praise You; with the survivors of wrath You will clothe Yourself.
passages.sermon:
God is the God of Jacob.
God sits in heaven.
God speaks judgment from heaven.
The earth hears God's judgment.
The earth becomes afraid.
The earth becomes silent.
God rises to judge.
God rises to save all the humble people on earth.
Even human anger will praise God.
God will wear the survivors of wrath as a sign of His power.
passages.original: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃ בְּקוּם־ לַמִּשְׁפָּ֥ט אֱלֹהִ֑ים לְהוֹשִׁ֖יעַ כָּל־ עַנְוֵי־ אֶ֣רֶץ סֶֽלָה׃ כִּֽי־ חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תּוֹדֶ֑ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃

passages.text: Make and fulfill your vows to the LORD your God; let all the neighboring lands bring tribute to Him who is to be feared.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is your God.
He is to be feared.
Make vows to the LORD your God.
Fulfill your vows to Him.
All the lands around you must bring tribute to Him.
He is the One who must be feared.
passages.original: נִֽדֲר֣וּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ֮ לַיהוָ֪ה אֱ‍ֽלֹהֵ֫יכֶ֥ם כָּל־ סְבִיבָ֑יו יוֹבִ֥ילוּ שַׁ֝֗י לַמּוֹרָֽא׃

passages.text: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
passages.sermon:
God acts with great power.
God breaks the spirits of princes.
God is awesome to the kings of the earth.
Kings of the earth fear God.
passages.original: יִ֭בְצֹר ר֣וּחַ נְגִידִ֑ים נ֝וֹרָ֗א לְמַלְכֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃
